name: clerk
concept: A tired man in his sixties who has sold bus tickets in a small-town depot for thirty years: thin grey hair combed over, deep lines, reading glasses on a cord, a faded blue short-sleeved uniform shirt with a name badge, dark trousers, worn black shoes, a pen in the shirt pocket.
description: Thin man in his sixties, grey comb-over, lined face, reading glasses on a cord around his neck, faded blue short-sleeved uniform shirt with a name badge, dark trousers, worn black shoes.
